description_overrides.infra-adapt.md: Build an independent generator with complete evidence contracts, semantic gates, fixtures, and fresh references for a confirmed non-PHP stack.
description_overrides.infra-build.md: One-shot scan, contract compilation, staged semantic generation, and transactional publication with required ambiguity/collision checkpoints.
description_overrides.infra-generate.md: Build an approved evidence-contracted accelerator in staging, validate semantics and routing, then publish selected editions with rollback.
description_overrides.infra-scan.md: Scan a target PHP project read-only and compile a human Profile plus validated evidence and per-skill generation contracts.
description_overrides.infra-validate.md: Review every generated file for uniqueness, completeness, accuracy, and coherence, repairing blocking findings through the owning forges.
description_overrides.infra-update.md: Upgrade a previously generated accelerator to the current evidence/semantic quality contract through staging, manifest ownership, and rollback.
